meta.description: Assignment of cause/effect (eitza) edge nodes to existing bechina-based packages for Torah #28. Each unassigned node from the cause/effect edges is placed into the package whose essential nature it shares.

assignments.reason: Bringing true Torah scholars into one's home is the practical means by which one attains chesed. The source text states: 'וְלָבוֹא לְחֶסֶד, אִי אֶפְשָׁר לָבוֹא אֶלָּא עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁיַּכְנִיס תַּלְמִידֵי־חֲכָמִים צַדִּיקִים לְתוֹךְ בֵּיתוֹ' — to come to chesed, one can only come through bringing true scholars into one's home. Furthermore, this hospitality is equated with offering the daily tamid sacrifice ('כְּאִלּוּ הִקְרִיב תְּמִידִין'), and the tamid/עולת תמיד is already in Package 1. The essential nature of this node is holy chesed-action: it is the practical expression of the faith/lovingkindness/Abraham cluster. It belongs in Package 1 (good).

edge_context.relationship: יכניס תלמידי־חכמים צדיקים לתוך ביתו → חסד
edge_context.direction: cause → effect (this node is the cause)

assignments.reason: The service of standing before the scholars and serving them is the specific act through which one merits chesed. The source text states: 'וּבְזֶה הַשִּׁמּוּשׁ שֶׁעוֹמֵד עֲלֵיהֶם וּמְשַׁמֵּשׁ אוֹתָם, זוֹכֶה לַחֶסֶד הַנַּ"ל', quoting 'כָּל הַמּוֹנֵעַ תַּלְמִידוֹ מִלְּשַׁמְּשׁוֹ כְּאִלּוּ מוֹנֵעַ מִמֶּנּוּ חֶסֶד'. This node is essentially the same domain as כבש (the lamb/one subdued under his master), already in Package 1 via additions. The lamb IS the one who is 'כָּבוּשׁ תַּחַת יַד רַבּוֹ וּמְשַׁמֵּשׁ אוֹתָם' — subdued under his master and serving them. The essential nature of humble service to true sages belongs squarely in the holy chesed/faith cluster.

edge_context.relationship: שמוש שעומד עליהם ומשמש אותם → חסד
edge_context.direction: cause → effect (this node is the cause)

assignments.reason: Subduing the evil worm is the triumphant action OF the holy worm (תולע דקדושה). The source text states: 'בְּחִינַת תּוֹלָע דִּקְדֻשָּׁה שֶׁמַּכְנִיעַ תּוֹלָע דִּקְלִפָּה' — the holy worm subdues the evil worm. The act of subduing is the expression of the holy worm's power, not the evil worm's domain. The essential nature of this node is holy victory/gevurah-of-chesed — 'בִּגְבוּרוֹת יֵשַׁע יְמִינוֹ' (with the mighty acts of salvation of His right hand). It is the active face of the faith/chesed/Abraham cluster, whose right hand (chesed) prevails in strength (gevurah). This belongs in Package 1 (good) as the martial expression of the holy worm.

edge_context.direction: cause → effect (this node is the effect)

assignments.node_text: מְשַׁבֵּר וּמְבַטֵּל עֲבוֹדָה־זָרָה וְהַכְּפִירוֹת וְהַבִּזְיוֹנוֹת, וּמִתְגַּבֵּר עַל הַכּוֹפְרִים
assignments.reason: Shattering idolatry and prevailing over the heretics is the outcome produced by faith/Abraham. The source text states: 'וּבִבְחִינַת אַבְרָהָם, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה, מְשַׁבֵּר וּמְבַטֵּל עֲבוֹדָה־זָרָה וְהַכְּפִירוֹת וְהַבִּזְיוֹנוֹת, וּמִתְגַּבֵּר עַל הַכּוֹפְרִים, בִּבְחִינַת: בִּגְבוּרוֹת יֵשַׁע יְמִינוֹ'. Although this node references the evil objects (idolatry, heresy) as what is being destroyed, its essential nature is the holy act of destruction/victory — not the evil itself. The agent is Abraham/faith, and the action is a triumphant manifestation of chesed-in-gevurah. It belongs in Package 1 (good) as the culminating expression of the faith/chesed cluster's power over the sitra achra.
